{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print("Number of rows with duplicate patient_id:", len(duplicates))

# Check sample_seq to see if higher sample_seq supersedes earlier ones
print("\nHighest sample_seq per patient:")
print(duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().head())"}
